title: Dissociation of microdissected mouse brain tissue for artifact free single-cell RNA sequencing
protocol: Anesthetize the mice.
Transcardially perfuse the mice with 20 mL of cold perfusion solution for 3–5 minutes.
Perform cervical dislocation.
Cut the head carefully and free the brain from the skull.
Transfer the brains to 15 mL tubes filled with ice-cold DPBS-CMF.
Set up the dissection workplace to keep tissue ice cold during dissection.
Dissect targeted brain regions in a petri dish filled with cold DBPS-CMF on ice.
Transfer dissected tissue to a new petri dish filled with cold Enzyme Mix 1 and transcription inhibitor actinomycin D, on ice.
Prepare separate petri dishes for each target region.
Perform the dissection as quickly as possible within less than 2 hours.
Add 30 μL of Enzyme Mix 2 to each C Tube.
Tightly close the C Tubes and attach them upside down onto the gentleMACS™ OctoDissociator.
Tap the tubes to move tissue on the walls into enzyme mix.
Run the “15 min dissociation program”.
Detach the C Tubes from the gentleMACS™ OctoDissociator upon completion of the program.
Place 70 μm filters on 50 mL tubes and pre-wet the filters with 500 μL of cold DPBS-CMF.
Filter the dissociated tissue samples by pouring the dissected tissues onto the filters.
Add 9.5 mL of cold DPBS-CMF into each C Tubes, shake them gently.
Add the liquid from the C Tubes to the respective filter to collect remaining tissue fragments and cells.
Discard the 70 μm filter.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant slowly and avoid disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet gently in 1550 μL of cold DPBS-CMF and transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Add 450 μL of cold Debris Removal Solution from the "Adult Brain Dissociation Kit".
Mix well by using a 1000 μL pipette.
Overlay very gently and slowly with 2 times 1 mL cold DPBS-CMF by using a 1000 μL pipette.
Centrifuge at 4°C and 3000 × g for 10 minutes with acceleration 9 and brake 9.
Aspirate the two top layers completely with a vacuum pump.
Fill the tube up to 5 mL with cold DPBS-CMF.
Gently invert the tube three times.
Centrifuge at 4°C and 1000 × g for 10 minutes with acceleration 9 and brake 9.
Aspirate supernatant completely and avoid disrupting the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 270 μL of loading buffer.
Add 30 μL Myelin Removal Beads II to the resuspended cell pellets.
Mix well with the pipette, but do not vortex.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Adjust the bead volume according to the data sheet for the target brain region.
Wash cells by adding 10 times the labeling volume of loading buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min.
Place the appropriate number of LS Columns in the magnetic field of a MACS Separator.
Rinse each column with 3 ml loading buffer.
Aspirate supernatant completely after centrifugation.
Add 1000 μl of loading buffer per LS Column and resuspend cells.
Apply cell suspension onto the LS column.
Collect unlabeled cells that pass through as myelin-free sample.
Wash the column twice with 1 ml loading buffer each time.
Filter collected cell suspension through a 30 μm filter pre-wetted with DPBS-CMF.
Centrifuge filtered suspension for 10 min at 300 × g at 4°C.
Count the cell number and viability to confirm that the requirements for loading the sample on a 10× Genomics Chromium Controller are fulfilled.
After final filtering, prepare the single-cell suspension for loading onto the 10× Genomics Chip.
Centrifuge the cells and discard the supernatant.
Gently resuspend gray matter cell pellets in 120–160 μL of loading buffer.
Resuspend white matter cell pellets in 60–80 μL of loading buffer.
Mix 10 μL of the cell suspension with 10 μL of trypan blue thoroughly.
Load the mixture into a manual cell counting slide or an automated cell counter to determine live and dead cells concentrations.
Adjust the cell concentration according to the recommendation of the 10× Genomics protocol.
Filter the low volume cell suspension through a 45 μm filter.
Detach the cap of a flow cytometry cell strainer from the tube and discard the tube.
Pre-wet the 45 μm filter in the cap with 1000 μL of DPBS-CMF.
Carefully add the sample on top of the filter.
Draw the hanging drop from the bottom of the filter with a 1000 μL pipette.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 300 × g at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet (up to 10^7 cells) gently in 50 μL of blocking buffer.
Incubate the samples for 10 min at 4°C.
Prepare the desired antibody staining mixture.
Add 50 μL of the prepared antibody staining mixture to each sample.
Incubate the samples for 20 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of DPBS-CMF to each sample.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 300 × g at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant by a vacuum pump and/or by pipettes.
Remove as much liquid as possible.
Add 500 μL of flow cytometry buffer to resuspend the pellet.
Put 7-AAD (final concentration: 25 μg/mL) in each sample.
Incubate for 5 min at 4°C in the dark.
Continue cell sorting in a single cell sorting mode with a flow cytometer selecting the proper gates for each antibody.
Use standard forward scatter height versus area criteria to discard doublets and capture singlets.
Use a membrane impermeant dye (7-AAD) for negative selection to remove dead cells.
Sort CD45+CD11b+ single cells into 96 or 384 well plates filled with lysis buffer for a plate-based scRNA-seq method such as Smart-Seq2.
